items.title: Howard Mandel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: I like the album he did with Bill Evans.

ctx.x: Yeah. I know my favorite guy is Cannonball. And I wonder if you ever saw him live?

No I just barely missed him. He was going to play at the University of Illinois Chicago Circle Campus and then I think the concert got canceled. I don’t think I ever saw him live. I like the album he did with Bill Evans.
